verdict.rationale: The SOS publishes its own turnaround commitments for paid expedite tiers: 24-hour and same-day online, a 4-hour Sacramento drop-off service, and 24-hour preclearance. It also says certificates of status are available within minutes online. None of this is a published current processing time or backlog for standard filings by transaction type. Missing for 10: a published current-processing-times page for standard (non-expedited) filings, per-transaction-type timing data, and evidence the times are kept current.
